tools.title: Tokens and cost calculator
tools.blurb: Daily and monthly spend from your traffic, token counts, cache share and the prices you enter.

spec.title: Output tokens and uncached input usually dominate the bill
spec.caption: Prices are illustrative placeholders: enter your provider’s current prices. Watch how the cached share changes the daily total.
spec.alt: Calculator for cost per request, per day and per month from token counts, cache share and prices.

outputs.label: Cost per request
outputs.expr: (in_tokens * (1 - cached_share) * price_in + in_tokens * cached_share * price_cached + out_tokens * price_out) / 1000000

assumptions: Reasoning tokens, if any, are billed as output: add them to output tokens.
Ignores cache-write surcharges and batch discounts.

spec.title: Dimensions and precision decide index memory: binary vectors are 32 times smaller
spec.caption: Formula view. The overhead factor stands in for graph links, metadata and replicas; measure your engine’s real overhead.
spec.alt: Calculator for vector count, raw vector bytes and total index memory.
assumptions: Text and metadata stored outside the vector index are not included.
